meta.title: Compare diagnostic test prices in Bangladesh
meta.description: Same test, different price. Compare CBC, dengue NS1, HbA1c, ultrasound, MRI and more across labs in your city before you pay.

hero.badge: Compare lab test prices in your city
hero.subtitle: Search a test, see every lab's price, report time and rating side by side, and find the best deal near you.
hero.scroll: Scroll to see how it works

gap.title: The same test can cost very different amounts
gap.text: Two labs a few streets apart can charge very different prices for the exact same test. A quick check can save you real money.
gap.sampleNote: Prices shown are sample data for demonstration.

search.title: Search
search.text: Type a test name in Bangla or English, or a short name like CBC or HbA1c.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: See price, report time, home collection, accreditation and rating for every lab.

save.title: Save
save.text: Pick the lab that suits you, and confirm the price with the lab before you go.

stats.title: DamJachai in numbers
stats.verified: Prices verified in the last 90 days

trust.title: How prices are checked
trust.text: Nothing is scraped. Every price is added by an admin or comes from a user report that an admin has reviewed.

admin.title: Added and checked by admins
admin.text: Admins enter prices from lab price lists and update them when they change.

reports.title: Reports from people like you
reports.text: Paid a different price? Report it. An admin reviews every report before it changes anything.

dates.title: Every price shows its date
dates.text: You always see when a price was last verified. Old prices are clearly marked.

cta.title: Ready to check your test price?
cta.text: Compare labs now, or help others by reporting the price you paid.
